description: Dated Santiago candidate assessment; native cadastral identity and commercial reuse not established.
officialIdentity: OCUC/Observatorio de Ciudades UC ArcGIS Online FeatureServer republication; claims MINVU as original data source, but service is third party, not an official MINVU endpoint.
sourceSemantics: Individual predio/parcel-like polygons classified by commune with surface attributes; not verified as SII cadastral roll polygons. No rol/account field available.
scope: Communes in Santiago Metropolitan Area only, not Chile-wide.
stableNativeField: Only FID (system-maintained object ID) observed; sample nonnull/unique 3/3 but no durable native parcel ID.
boundedSample: Existing response bbox [-70.6545,-33.4925,-70.6525,-33.4910], 3 San Miguel polygons; exceededTransferLimit=true; not complete. Sample area attributes flagged as inconsistent with Shape__Area in existing research.
lookupAndPaging: FeatureServer supports GeoJSON, pagination; native property lookup unavailable. objectId=FID would only resolve current service record.
terms: OCUC item states CC BY-NC 4.0 for its publication, subject to MINVU source terms; commercial redistribution is not established. Official SII document calls its maps referential and not evidence of parcel boundaries; it describes a WMS/image service rather than public vectors.
blockers: Third-party OCUC republication; MINVU source terms unresolved.
No native cadastral ID/rol, only system FID.
Noncommercial published license plus attribute anomalies.
